notes: Ordinary is the explicit definition variant; it does not assert absent sift-proofing, coating, lining or closure.
The official definition describes a cylindrical rotating support with a rim at each end for wound material; it does not declare body material.
COLOUR and mesh construction preserve the official red-netting definition. The net's fibre or polymer is not specified.
The definition retains bundle/bunch/truss alternatives without selecting one of them or asserting a packaging-body material.
PROFILE describes the explicitly shallow crate form, not a measured depth or an inferred material.
The official definition is a low movable handling platform or pallet; no wood, wheels or dimensional values are asserted.

The adopted official definition specifically describes hard plastic sheeting used as a load base. This definition is narrower than every colloquial use of slipsheet; no inference rule for arbitrary source wording is introduced.
COMMODITY_MATERIAL describes the sheet cargo, not the body material of an enclosing package.
The official definition describes a transport package for wound items such as cable or yarn; it does not establish a particular body material.
A wrapping sheet is expressly named. This is not a claim that the enclosed commodity is plastic.
WRAPPING records the explicit shrink-wrapping treatment; the component preserves its defined transparent plastic film. No underlying box, bag, pallet or other package family is established.
PACKING_STATE preserves the official loose/unpacked article definition. Tablet is a cargo form here, not an inferred medicinal product, composition or outer package.
Collapsible is explicitly the tube's construction. No plastic, metal, nozzle or closure is inferred.
The official tyre definition permits rubber and/or metal; COMMODITY_MATERIAL preserves those alternatives without selecting a primary packaging-body material or asserting both constituents.

The definition is equipment-shaped; a code occurrence alone does not determine whether it is carrying equipment, goods or the declared package in a particular document. No pressure, temperature, size, material or contents choice is supplied.
The saved application's trailing TI is retained in its display label by the loader, not interpreted as a material, dimension or separate standard.
Tin is retained as the named package family; the noun alone does not establish a body made of elemental tin or a particular alloy.
The unqualified trade form is preserved without assuming a wooden body, a particular commodity, or equivalence to every bundled package.
The named tote-bag variant remains distinct; its official capacious bag/basket description does not supply a specific body material or a numeric capacity.

The official dispensing-tube definition permits plastic, metal or cardboard bodies and liquid or semi-liquid contents. No single material is selected from those alternatives; the compound CONTENTS_FORM value preserves the stated disjunction.

The official definition supplies heavy-duty corrugated board. CORRUGATED_BOARD preserves that material wording rather than silently equating cardboard and fibreboard or inferring a numeric layer count.
Uncaged explicitly states absence of a cage, not an affirmative package family. It does not establish absence of every other support or wrapping.

The official definition counts a single item/object not otherwise specified as a transport-equipment unit. It supplies no package body or material, and does not itself assign a document's cargo or carrying-equipment role.
Pressure and temperature are explicit conditions in this bulk-gas code's definition, not inferred operating settings for carrying equipment.
The official definition identifies a wooden crate; Vanpack here is not a road vehicle, carrier, brand inference or container-equipment alias.

PROPULSION preserves the official self-propelled-conveyance definition without inferring fuel, hazard or packing state. Equipment-shaped kind does not assign carrying-equipment rather than cargo ownership in a document.
PACKAGING_PROCESS records the explicit treatment without inventing a bag, box or other enclosure family, a body material or a numeric vacuum pressure.

TEMPERATURE_PRESSURE_CONDITION preserves the definition's joint 'abnormal temperature/pressure' wording. It does not independently assert which condition differs, numeric thresholds, a pressure comparator or an equipment temperature/pressure setting.
Scrap metal describes bulk cargo, not the material of a package body. PACKING_STATE preserves the official loose/unpacked definition without inventing an enclosing container or package.
